name: lightning_strikes_binding_tier2
description: v2.1 candidate (Unreleased): demonstrates BOTH lightning mechanisms binding visibly. Base TV-001 modified with wind_now=18 (windScore=10, windComp=8), rain_prob=30 (rule_1, rainScore=10), instability_index=0.10 (low), thunder_risk=0 (forecast says no thunder), and lightning_strikes_30min_5km=5. Mechanism A: 5 ≥ thunder_force_threshold=1 → effective_thunder_risk forced 0→1, activating thunder_add=+5 in WeatherNow. Mechanism B: 3 ≤ 5 < 10 → tier_2_adj=+15 added directly to risk_score. raw_baseline = 4.4+3.5+0.2-5.1 = 3.0; raw_lightning = 4.4+3.5+0.2-5.1+5 = 8.0. weather_now: 3.0 → 8.0 (Δ=+5 from forcing). risk_score = round(9 + weather_now + 6 + 0 + 0 + lightning_adj) = round(18) = 18 baseline; round(9 + 8.0 + 6 + 0 + 0 + 15) = round(38) = 38 with lightning. Δ risk_score = +20 (= +5 forcing inside weather_now + +15 tier adder). R-level R0 → R1. Decision GO both ways under wr_matrix.W0.R1=go. Spec: §5.6 (Unreleased).
